reason: The hypothesis directly restates the known behavior of Q235 steel's passive film (early protection, then rupture and acceleration) from P1 and P7, and the effect of temperature on Fe3+ content from P21, P23 and P30, proposing a controlled treatment to enhance this film as if it were a new prediction, which is essentially the same idea already reported in those passages.
copied_elements: passive film provides early corrosion protection (P1, P7)
passive film rupture leads to accelerated corrosion (P1, P4)
higher temperature promotes Fe3+ oxide (Fe2O3) formation in passive film (P21, P23, P30)
denser, Fe3+-rich passive film enhances corrosion resistance (P21, P23, P30)
